description: Pipeline ground truth — small profile (days=30, entities=100, seed=42, stream seed=7). Generated by the deterministic pipeline sources; verified by verify-pipeline-data.mts.

model_auc_decline.expect: ads.model_metrics: mean AUC of lgb_v2 after anomaly day < mean AUC before

feature_missingness_rise.expect: dws.feature_values: missing rate after anomaly day > before

feature_distribution_drift.expect: dws.feature_values: mean debt_ratio after anomaly day ≈ before + 0.2

data_freshness_anomaly.description: prediction_points stop 2 days before the end of the range
data_freshness_anomaly.expect: dws.prediction_points: no rows for the last 2 days

label_distribution_change.description: loan status distribution shifts after ANOMALY_DAY (null borrower_score batch)
label_distribution_change.expect: dwd.loan_application_detail: null borrower_score rows exist only after anomaly day

stream_duplicates.description: 6 duplicate event_ids in the stream; facts written exactly once

stream_late.description: late events within watermark accepted and counted
stream_late.expect: stream counters: late > 0 and all late events present in ODS

stream_too_late.description: too-late events beyond watermark go to dead letter, never ODS
stream_too_late.expect: stream counters: tooLate = 4; ODS contains no too_late event_ids

stream_invalid.description: invalid schema events go to dead letter, never ODS
stream_invalid.expect: stream counters: invalid = 4; ODS contains no invalid rows

missing_partition.description: prediction_inputs source omits the last 2 days (freshness)
